translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Golaiati iyokoli mina Isireli
Mina Pilisitia igugulasi mapilana Sokou oviluwela Yuda paila bikabiliasi. E isailisi kasi kabeikau makatupona yagala Epesi Damin oluwalaisi Sokou deli Aseka.
Saulo deli mina Isireli igugulasi ibudaisi kasi kabeikau oitayatilela mapilana Ela e baisa eikatubaiasasi paila biyowaisi deli mina Pilisitia.
Pilatala dubakaila mina Pilisitia eitodadelisi, piliyuwela mina Isireli, e oluwalaisiga itayatila.
E taitala tau yagala Golaiati tolela Gata, e isunapula metoya okasi kabeikau mina Pilisitia paila biyokoli mina Isireli. E matauna kala woloula iboda uvatala tomwaidona.
E isisikam wowola vayoulela barasi wala, mokaila makawala luwotala yuwa peta (57 kg), deli kala kulupewa tuvaila barasi wala.
E kaikela tuvaila isim tabodala barasi, e ikatikeu la kaiyala kaikekita barasi wala.
E la kaiyala kaiveka popoula makawala bubotala pou, e matala makaina aiyani wala, mokaila makawala tala peta e ikatapwana (7 kg). E taitala tokwabilia ivasekala omatala matauna, e tokeula la vayoula.

E Golaiati itotu iukuwakula baisa mina Isireli kawala, “Tauwau, avaka lokuuvagaisi baisa, kuuvadadelisi paila yowai? Tauwau, yeigu guma Pilisitia, yokomiga Saulo la ula! Ibodi bukunagaisi taitala mi tokwabilia bima kayowai.
Kidamwa matauna bitomgwaga e bikatumataigu, e bukuvigakaimasi mi ula, mitaga kidamwa yeigu batomgwaga e bakatumati matauna, bakavigakaimi ma ulasi.
Lagaila wala bayokolaimi, yokomi tokwabilia mina Isireli. Magigu wala bukunagaisi availa bima kayowai.”
Avai tuta Saulo deli la tokwabilia ilagaisi baisa e saina ikokoluvagasisi.
Debida itotu Saulo okala kabeikau
Debida matauna Yese latula matauna guma Eparati metoya Bedeliem mapilana Yuda. Yese litula tailima taitolu, e tuta matutona Saulo eiguyau, matauna Yese bogwa eitomoya.
E litula taitolu tovakaveka ilosi ikabiliasi deli Saulo. Molitomoya Eliabi, eisakaili Abinadaba, e taitolula Samma.
E Debida la kasusu. E avai tuta tuwʹala isisuaisi deli Saulo,
e Debida isilavi tuwʹala ikaimilavau Bedeliem, paila biyamati tamala la sipi.
E yam kwaitala kwaitala kaukwau deli koyavi matauna Golaiati iiyokoli wala mina Isireli iboda kweluwovasi yam.
Kwaitala yam, Yese iluki Debida, kawala, “Kukwau matasina yuwa petala witi kwegubugabu deli makwaisina kweluwotala beredi, e bukunanakwa bukuuyoki tuwamwa okabeikau.
Deli kukwau makaposina kapoluwotala tutuba kusaiki si kumatoula. Kunevikoli tuwamwa ammakawala bulogasi, e kumai avai kabutuvatusi bagisi basimokwita kidamwa lokubani matausina deli bulogasi bwaina.
E ka, guyau Saulo, deli tuwamwa deli goli komwaidosi mina Isireli, matausina eiyowaisi deli mina Pilisitia oitayatilela Ela.”

E eiyam kaukwau pikekita Debida itokaia isilavi minasina sipi e availa wala iiyamata, ikau makwaina kaula e ivatuboulola avaka Yese bogwa eiluki matauna bivagi. E tutala mina Isireli itokaiasi bilosi okawakali e iwaiweyasi deli si gidaleiya, e matutona goli Debida iviloubusi okabeikau.
Mina Pilisitia deli mina Isireli ilaisi kabasi okawakali, itovilakaisi sesia mitasi mitasi.
Debida iligaim kaula deli tosikwawa matauna kaula kala toyamata e isakaula ila okawakali e ilokaia tuwʹala ibudobodasi.
Avai tuta eibigatona baisa matausina, Golaiati ivalapula e iyokoli mina Isireli makawala eivigibogwi. E Debida ililagi matauna.
Avai tuta mina Isireli igisaisi Golaiati, e isakaulasi paila kasi kokola deli itatatuvasi.

E ititamapusi taitala baisa taitala kawasi, “Ka, kugisaisi matauna! Kulagaisi eiyokoli! E ka, guyau Saulo eilavi puwaya saina kwaiveka baisa matauna availa bikatumati matauna tilaula; e guyau tuvaila bikasali latula vivila bivaiya; deli biligaim veyala kasi karaiwaga kidamwa gala tuvaila bipokapokalasi.”

Debida ikatupoi matausina tauwau eitotusi katitaikinela matauna, kawala, “Tauwau, kidamwa availa bikatumati matauna guma Pilisitia e biuwoli kasi mmosila mina Isireli e avai mapula matauna bibani? Ki, avai tauga matauna guma Pilisitia, matauna gala inikoli Yaubada, e mwada biyokoli Yaubada Tosivagasi la tokwabilia?”
E matausina ilukwaisi Debida avai mapula bikaloubusi baisa availa matauna bikatumati Golaiati.

E Eliabi matauna Debida tuwala molitomoya bogwa eilagi Debida ililivalasi deli matausina tauwau. E matauna saina igibuluwa e ikawota iluki Debida kawala, “Ei, mwa, yoku! Avaka kuuvagi baisa ke? Ki, availaga iiyamati mayuwona sipi minasina lokusilavi olawodila? Yoku saina minimani wodom! Yoku lokuma mwada bukugigisi wala kabilia kadai!”
E Debida ikawota ikatupoi kawala, “Mna! ki, avaka bogwa lavagi? Ki, gala sitana ibodi bakatupoi avaka? Wo!”
E itovilaki ikatupoi taitala tuvaila mabigana wala. E ikatupoi bidubadu tomota e komwaidosi imapwaisi makwaina katupoi makawala wala.
Mitaga mimilisi tauwau bogwa leilagaisi avaka Debida ililivali, e matausina ilosi isolasi baisa Saulo. E Saulo idou Debida bimakaia.
Debida iluki Saulo kawala, “Mwa! Ulo guyau yoku - ka, gala availa ibodi bikukoli matauna guma Pilisitia! E yeigu ibodaigu wala balokaia matauna kayowai.”
E Saulo ivitakauloki kawala, “Waa, gala! Ki, ammakawalaga yoku bukuvigaki yowai deli matauna? Paila yoku saina wala gwadi, mitaga matauna bogwa eibisibasi okabilia ola tuta komwaidona!”
Debida ikaibiga, kawala, “Mwa! Ulo guyau yoku - ka, yeigu toyamatela wala tamagu la sipi. Avai tuta laiyoni kaina beya bikalileu lam,
e yeigu babokavili minana bawaiya e bakoli lam. E kidamwa laiyoni kainaga beya bitovilakaigu, e yeigu bayosi kaiyola bawaiya e bakatumati.
Ka, yeigu bogwa lakatumati bidubadu laiyoni deli beya. E tuvaila bavigaki makawala wala baisa matauna guma Pilisitia gala inikoli Yaubada, paila matauwenala eiyokoli Yaubada Tosivagasi la tokwabilia.

E Guyau bogwa ikolaigu metoya minasina laiyoni deli beya, e makawala goli matauna tuvaila bikolaigu metoya baisa matauna guma Pilisitia.” Saulo ivitakaula kawala, “E saina bwaina. Bukula. Guyau matauna deli yoku.”
Saulo ikasali la guguwa kabilia titoulela baisa Debida paila mwada bisikam. E ikau kala kulupewa eibubulokaisi metoya barasi isaili opwanetala Debida, e tuvaila isikoma vayoulela wowola.

Debida ikau Saulo la puluta isagi, e ivigikoni mwada biloula, mitaga gala igagabila, paila uula gala ikabitutuki sikam makwaisina. E matauna iluki Saulo kawala, “Mwa! Gala ibodi bayowai deli guguwa makwaisina, paila gala bikabitutukwaigu kala sisikam makwaisina.” Mapaila ivilili komwaidona makwaisina iligaim.
E matauna ikau la kaitukwa deli isau kwailima dakuna kwedudubuna metoya wa sakala isewoya okala kauya e ikatuvakai la peu e ila bibodi Golaiati.
Debida ikalisau Golaiati
E Golaiati ivaloula imakaia Debida, deli la vayoula kala tokeula eililoula omatala. Matauna ililoula wala imakaia katitaikina,
e avai tuta bogwa igisibwelaki kala gigisa Debida, matauna ivigaki kala yousokana, paila wala saina tokekita deli tomanabwaita.
Matauna iluki Debida kawala, “Avaka kaila makaina lokuiyosi? Ki kudoki yeigu kaukwa ke?” Mapaila Golaiati ibuloti Debida omatala la yaubada titoulela.
Matauna ikammalu Debida kawala, “Mwa! Kawam pia! Kuma nani akatumataim, e wowom bikomasi mauna nayoyowa deli nasigisagina.”

Debida ivitakauloki kawala, “Ka, yoku mwada bukuyowaiyaigu metoya puluta deli kaiyala, mitaga yeigu lamakaiam oyagala wala Guyau Topeuligaga, matauna mina Isireli tokwabilia si Yaubada, matauwena goli lokuyokoli.

E yam lagaila wala Guyau bisailim oyamagu. Yeigu bakatumataim e bakapituni kaiyom. E mina Pilisitia uwosi bikomasi mauna nayoyowa deli nasigisagina. E tomota ovalu watanawa komwaidona binikolaisi mina Isireli isim si Yaubada.

E availa availa isisuaisi baisa bigisaisi Guyau gala ninikelala bikau puluta kaina kaiyala paila bikoli la tomota. Matauna tuta komwaidona bitomgwaga wala okabilia, e komwaidomi wala bisailimi oyumamaisi.”
E Golaiati ivaloula tuvaila ilokaia Debida, e Debida isakaula ilokaia mina Pilisitia okasi kawakali, paila bikabilia deli matauna.

E Debida isewoya yamala okala kauya e ikau kwaitala dakuna. Makwaina ikatuwayai ola peu ilavi ilokaia Golaiati. E ibabeula wala ila ivia busubosala e ikatuvi wala kwavigela dabala, e Golaiati ikapusi ikanubiaki wala opwaipwaia.
E ka, Debida gala wala deli la puluta, mitaga ikalisau Golaiati e ikatumati matauna metoya peu deli dakuna!

Debida isakaula ilokaia matauna, itola otapwala e ikau Golaiati la kema paila kabilia metoya ola kabosakaila e ikatumati matauna ikapituni kaiyola. Avai tuta mina Pilisitia igisaisi si kumatoula bogwa eikaliga, e matausina isakaulasi.

E mina Isireli deli mina Yuda ikawotasi ibokavilaisi matausina, e ibokavilaisi wala ilauwaisi mapilana Gata deli okalapisilela Ekironi. E mina Pilisitia ikatubuyavi uwosi ikikapusisi otapwala keda makadana biloula Saraim, kala kaduwonaku makawala biloula Gata deli Ekironi.
E avai tuta mina Isireli ikaimilavausi metoya obwakavila mina Pilisitia, matausina ikilibulebusi avaka magisi metoya okasi kabeikau mina Pilisitia.
E Debida ikau Golaiati pwanetala e ilau Yerusalem. Mitaga Golaiati la guguwa paila kabilia iyamati wala ola buliyoyova titoulela.
Debida iuyokaisi Saulo

Avai tuta Saulo bogwa eigisi Debida eitokaia bilokaia biyowaisi sola Golaiati, e Saulo ikatupoi Abina, matauna la tokwabilia si kumatoula, kawala, “Mwa! Abina, ami yagala tamala magudina?” E Abina ivitakauloki Saulo kawala, “Mwa! Ulo guyau, eisekila! Yeigu gala wala anikoli.”
E Saulo ikaraiwogi Abina kawala, “Kula kukwatupoi.”
Mapaila wa tuta matutona Debida ikaimilavau okabeikau tutala bogwa eikatumati Golaiati e Abina ivakouli matauna iuyoki Saulo. E Debida deli wala ikikau Golaiati pwanetala.
E Saulo ikatupoi matauna kawala, “Mwa! Monagwadi, ki, ami yagala tamam?” E Debida ivitakauloki Saulo kawala, “Yeigu tamagu Yese, matauna m touwata guma Bedeliem.”
